propositions: autodeploy recreates the review-bot container mid-review without draining in-flight work, killing code reviews before they can vote
the reconciler retry path lacks protection from recreation because it awaits review_and_vote inline outside the queue, whereas webhook-queued reviews have queue.join() drainage
landing bursts with deploy gaps shorter than review duration cause repeated kills of the same review, live-locking the LLM-Review gate while all health signals remain green

deferral is implemented by checking an in_flight counter on the existing /health endpoint and skipping deployment if busy, keyed to the deferral episode not the target SHA to prevent timer reset during bursts
the defer bound is set to 1800s (1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) ensuring only chronically busy bots trigger the bound, never a single ordinary review
new countable tokens AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT enable alarming on the previously-blind interrupt failure mode independent of provider changes
